tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find paid APIs on the Ego Agent marketplace. Free, read-only. Returns each API's id, price in USDC, who runs it and how many paid calls it has had. Leave query empty to list everything.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Everything needed to call one paid API found with search_services: its url, price, the wallet it is paid to, its input and how to pay over x402. Free, read-only; it does not call or pay the API.

tools.name: trade_check
tools.description: PAID tool, run by Ego Agent. Before a trade on Arc: is this pool safe to trade in right now, how far would this amount move the price, and how much may one trade carry. Measured from the pool on chain at the moment of the call. Payment is x402 over MCP in USDC on Arc: call it without a payment to be
